architecture.name: SubmissionService
architecture.description: Handles online assignment submission, file upload, submission timestamps, and submission status.

architecture.name: AccessControlService
architecture.description: Provides authentication, authorization, role-based access control, and protection of student academic information.

architecture.name: NotificationService
architecture.description: Sends notifications to students when grades are published or other academic events occur.

database.name: Student
database.description: Stores student profile, account, and identity information.

database.name: AssignmentSubmission
database.description: Stores assignment submissions including student, assignment, uploaded file reference, submission time, and status.

database.name: Grade
database.description: Stores student grades, assessment results, feedback, and grade publication status.

database.name: AuditRecord
database.description: Stores audit records for access to grades, grade changes, and important academic system activities.

api.name: POST /assignments/{id}/submit
api.description: Allows a student to upload and submit work for a specific assignment.

api.name: GET /grades
api.description: Returns grade information to an authenticated and authorized user.

api.name: POST /auth/login
api.description: Authenticates users using valid account credentials before accessing protected system resources.

components.name: AssignmentSubmissionComponent
components.description: Provides the user-facing and application functionality for uploading and submitting assignments.

components.name: GradeManagementComponent
components.description: Provides functionality for managing, viewing, and publishing student grades.

components.name: SecurityComponent
components.description: Implements authentication, authorization, access control, and protection of academic information.

components.name: GradeNotificationComponent
components.description: Generates and sends notifications to students when grades are published.
